audit.why: Emerald+ 48.28% over 872 games. The text's 'you win lane, he wins the game' arc matches a sub-50 rate driven by Stand United rather than by lane losses.

Rumble takes 2-3 and level 6, Shen owns two items and everything after. Correct. The distinctive feature is that lane difficulty and game difficulty diverge here: Shen never has to beat Rumble in the side lane because Stand United (200s at rank 1) decides dragons and picks elsewhere, and the text already says so.

Four spikes: level 2-3 pattern, Rumble's 6, Shen's 6, two items. The 'His Lvl 6' entry correctly identifies Stand United as a map event rather than a lane event, which is the right read for a 200/180/160s global.

audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup treats Spirit's Refuge as a general damage block that blunts Rumble's kill window, and it names Shen's Q as 'Ki Strike'. Both are wrong. It also says Shadow Dash interrupts the Flamespitter channel.
audit.why: Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks: Riot's text is 'Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.' Flamespitter is an ability, not an attack, and it burns through the zone untouched — which inverts the advice. The correct instruction is to keep the cone on him and simply stop auto-attacking inside it, rather than backing off as the current text implies. Shen's Q is Twilight Assault, a 400-range spirit-blade attack dealing damage based on the target's max health and slowing on collision; 'Ki Strike' is not in his kit at all and Ki Barrier is his passive, a shield after each spell cast. And Flamespitter, per Riot, 'deals magic damage in a cone for 3 seconds' — it carries no channel and is not interruptible by his taunt.

notes: 'Ki Strike' is a fabricated ability name — Shen's Q is Twilight Assault and Ki Barrier is his passive. It appears twice: in whys[2] (fixed here) and in the content 'early' paragraph, which reads 'his Q Ki Strike is a passive empowerment'. I could not fix the second inside the length band without rewriting the whole paragraph, so flagging it: champ-data/content/rumble.js, rumble vs shen, 'early'. The Spirit's Refuge misunderstanding is the more valuable fix — the old text told the player his damage was blocked when in fact only his auto-attacks are, which is the difference between disengaging and winning the trade.
